events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Remember the day music television changed forever? MTV launched on this date in 1981, and its first video was The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. The irony isn't lost on us.

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album, Definitely Maybe, on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago today, Oasis unleashed 'Definitely Maybe' on the world. What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, a generation gathered for three days of peace, love, and music. Happy anniversary to the iconic Woodstock Festival!

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, The King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legacy continue to shake up the world.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur, the influential rapper, passed away on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed in 1996. His words and music still resonate fiercely.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, the groundbreaking guitarist, passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album Abbey Road on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Celebration
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history, but what's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer and co-founder of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The iconic voice of The Pretenders, still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a celebrated solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The rock 'n' roll star still bringing the swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's profound solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Reflection
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and unity that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched the device that changed how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Happy Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since Dr. No first hit screens. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we celebrate the life and enduring legacy of John Lennon, who would have been 86. Imagine all the music...

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the iconic British comedian and actor known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album," on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Celebration
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What are your standout tracks?
